title: Ghostship · Autonomous work
description: Provisioned read-only Ghostship monitoring. Direct navigation; data comes from the existing SIEM stores.

options.content:
[Work overview](/d/ghostship-autonomous-work) · [Host](/d/ghostship-host) · [Security](/d/ghostship-security) · [Pipeline](/d/ghostship-siem-pipeline)

One read-only pane for T3 projects, ordinary and child agents, schedules, webhooks, reviews and provider usage. Today in UTC. **Bulk work, model reports, CI proofs, review receipts, closed pull requests and deployment receipts are different evidence: a receipt is never a green outcome. The CI proof is bound to the exact SHA of the configured checks; no owner state records a frontier approval, the merge result or the deployed health, and no source exposes objective completion** (see the coverage table). A count is a lower bound while a source is truncated or unavailable; an empty panel is missing evidence, not a healthy zero. No transcripts, prompts or raw failures are stored. [AI usage and model rankings](/d/ghostship-ai-usage) live in their own dashboard.

panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description: Failed, blocked or held work in the last snapshot. A truncated source makes this a lower bound.

targets.expr: sum((ghostship_work_attention and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180))

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Recorded active states: native runs, child tasks, queued jobs and running threads. A recorded state is not proof of liveness.

targets.expr: sum((ghostship_work_active and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180))

panels.title: Work items today
panels.description: Distinct work items with a UTC-day change, deduplicated across the one-minute polls. Sources that are down or truncated lower this count.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:!=coverage event_today:1 | stats count() n

panels.title: Webhook receipts today
panels.description: Webhooks that fired today, deduplicated across polls. Acceptance per receipt is in the webhook table; a missing receipt is missing evidence.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:=webhook fired_today:1 | stats count() n

panels.title: Sources unavailable
panels.description: Sources that failed to read in the last snapshot. Their counts are absent, not zero.

targets.expr: (count(ghostship_work_source_up == 0) or vector(0)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Seconds since the last collector snapshot. A stale snapshot means unknown, not zero.

targets.expr: time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds

panels.title: Model reports
panels.description: States a provider or the runtime reported about work. A report is not CI, deployment or objective proof. Unknown while the reporting source is unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="model_report"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: CI proofs
panels.description: Pull requests with a recorded configured CI proof on the exact head or merge SHA. The proof is not objective completion and not a deployed state. Unknown while the source is unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="ci_proof"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: CI failures
panels.description: Recorded CI proofs whose outcome is failed. No record is not a pass: the proof source fails closed and a stale revision is invalidated. Unknown while the source is unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_ci_failures and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Review receipts
panels.description: Independent review receipts: a review was submitted. The verdict is not recorded, and no owner state records a frontier approval. Unknown while the source is unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="review"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Pull requests closed
panels.description: Pull request closed receipts. Closed is not merged: the merge result is not recorded. Unknown while the receipt source is unavailable.

targets.expr: sum(ghostship_work_evidence_items{evidence="pr_closed"} and on(source) (ghostship_work_source_up == 1)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.title: Truncated sources

targets.expr: (count(ghostship_work_source_limited == 1) or vector(0)) and on() (time() - ghostship_work_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 180)

panels.description: Sources whose row cap truncated the history. Their counts and lists are lower bounds.

panels.title: Next up  /  schedules & timer initiators
panels.description: Enabled schedules with a next run, plus host systemd timers. The enable flag, the next run, the last run and the last result are separate facts.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=schedule | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter enabled:1 next_at:* | sort by (next_at) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,source,unit,trigger,enabled,next_at,event_at,status,last_status,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Attention  /  failures & held work
panels.description: Latest state per work item in a failure, blocked or held state.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter status:in(failed,error,blocked,held,denied,timeout,uncertain,upstream_blocked,unavailable,partial,conflict,dispatch_failed,rejected_signature,rate_limited) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: In flight  /  recorded runs, subagents & queues
panels.description: Recorded active states across native runs, child agents and runtime queues.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter kind:in(run,subagent,job,workflow,review,continuation) status:in(pending,queued,running,starting,in_progress,waiting,requested,native-running,preparing,prepared,executing) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,provider,evidence,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Today  /  durable state timeline
panels.description: State changes recorded today (UTC). Repeated polls do not multiply entries, and a state transition stays visible next to its earlier state.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:24h kind:in(run,subagent,job,launch,workflow,review,request,continuation) | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id,event_at,status) | filter event_today:1 | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,provider,evidence,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Webhook fires  /  last 24 h receipt time & outcome
panels.description: Fired webhooks with their receipt time and outcome. The evidence class separates CI and deployment receipts from other receipts.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:24h kind:=webhook | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (fired_at desc) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,fired_at,event_at,source,work_id,event,action,evidence,status,github_url

panels.title: Coverage  /  freshness, limits & read cost
panels.description: Per-source coverage of the last snapshot. A gap is a missing source, not an empty result; objective completion has no source today.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=coverage | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (source) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,source,coverage,reason,rows,limited,duration_seconds

panels.title: CI proof  /  configured checks on the exact SHA
panels.description: The coordinator CI proof of each pull request: the outcome, the merge flag, the required check count and the failing check count, bound to the exact revision. It proves configured checks on that revision, nothing else.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=ci_proof | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,outcome,merged,required_checks,failed_checks,revision,github_url,thread_url

panels.title: Schedule inventory  /  enabled, disabled & timers
panels.description: Every known schedule, including disabled ones and host timers, with its next run, last run and last result.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=schedule | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (source,unit,work_id) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,source,unit,trigger,enabled,next_at,event_at,status,last_status,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Source health  /  last successful read age
panels.description: Seconds since each source last read successfully. A source that never succeeded has no row here; the snapshot age above catches a collector failure.

targets.expr: time() - last_over_time(ghostship_work_source_last_success_seconds[24h])

panels.title: Projects  /  native inventory
panels.description: Native T3 projects, including projects without agent activity. At most 200 rows per source: a truncated source is a lower bound, not a complete inventory.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=project | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (project_id) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,project_id,thread_count,event_at,coverage

panels.title: Threads  /  manual, ordinary & agent work
panels.description: Ordinary and agent threads across every project, with the latest recorded state. At most 200 rows per source: a truncated source is a lower bound, not a complete inventory.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:=thread | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _msg,_time,event_at,project_id,work_id,status,provider,evidence,thread_url,github_url

panels.title: Handoffs & evidence  /  reviews, artifacts & continuations
panels.description: Review reports, provider routing, model continuations and every open pull request artifact. A review report is a model report; a reserved slot or an accepted switch is a receipt, not objective completion.

targets.expr: stream:=autonomous-work _time:3m kind:in(review,thread,artifact,request,routing,continuation) | last 1 by (_time) partition by (source,kind,work_id) | filter (kind:in(review,request,routing,continuation) OR github_url:*) | sort by (event_at desc) limit 200 | fields _time,_msg,event_at,source,kind,work_id,status,evidence,action,occupied,next_at,provider,switch_accepted,message_accepted,native_run_count,executing_count,route_state,primary_quota,route_reason,fallback,thread_url,github_url
